title: Oops! Paul Pelosi Hits a Parked Car and Drives Off
summary: Imagine you're walking down the street and you see a brown convertible bump into a parked car — then drive away! That's what happened in Yountville, California, a town in wine country. The driver was Paul Pelosi, the husband of former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi. He was 86 years old. The crash happened on a Friday. The parked car got "major" damage, but no one was hurt. A witness saw it and called 911. Deputies found Mr. Pelosi about a quarter mile away with damage to the front of his car. He told officers he knew he hit something but wasn't sure what or when. The sheriff's office said he didn't have any alcohol in his system. But because of his age, they sent him to the DMV to check if he can still drive safely. This isn't the first time Paul Pelosi has been in trouble with driving. In 2022, he pleaded guilty to driving under the influence (DUI) in the same county. He got five days in jail and three years of probation. He also had to take a class about drinking and driving and install a device in his car that checks his breath before the car starts. That same year, he was attacked at home with a hammer. So it's been a tough few years for him.
why_it_matters: It reminds us that all drivers, no matter their age or fame, must be careful and always stop to take responsibility after an accident.
